First, the sintering temperature was raised to 1700 ◦C with a heating rate of 100 ◦C/min and held for 10 min, during which no normal pressure was applied to the specimen surface. After that, when the temperature was decreased to 1600 ◦C, a pressure of 35 MPa was applied to the specimen and held for 10 min, and finally cooled to room temperature.
